title: Explaining the erroneous Alec Pierce report; recapping Colts-Patriots joint practice
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and Jim Ayello explain the erroneous report about Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Alec Pierce receiving a second platelet-rich plasma injection in his ankle. Pierce did not get a second injection, Colts GM Chris Ballard announced. Boyd and Ayello also recap the Colts' joint practice against the New England Patriots and look ahead to their preseason opener. Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company. title: Nix Out for Preseason Opener — Should Fans Worry & Why DEN Is Playing It Safe | Orange & Blue Today
text: Bo Nix has been ruled out of Friday’s preseason opener against the Falcons, and while some fans might feel a little disappointed, this is exactly what the Broncos expected — and exactly what they planned. Nix is coming back from ankle surgery, but he’s been fully practicing, looking sharp, and showing command of the offense. The team simply isn’t willing to risk their franchise quarterback in a preseason game that doesn’t matter. This is about protection, not concern. So how many starters won’t play Friday? Quite a few. Sean Payton is clearly prioritizing health over reps, and several key players — including Nix — will be held out to ensure they’re ready for joint practices and the regular season. 🔥 In this episode: Why Bo Nix sitting is smart, not alarming Bo Nix has looked good in camp despite the ankle recovery How many starters are expected to sit Friday Sean Payton’s preseason philosophy: protect the core What fans should watch for vs. Atlanta Drop your Broncos take — are you good with Nix sitting, or do you want to see him get preseason reps.
